name: Vaultwarden
description: A password manager for the whole family that works with the Bitwarden apps and browser extensions.

settings.label: Admin page token
settings.hint: Opens /admin, where users are invited and settings changed.

settings.label: HTTPS
settings.hint: Serves the web vault over HTTPS with FreedomNAS's own certificate, the one of its web interface.

note: Browsers open the web vault only over HTTPS. With HTTPS on it uses the certificate FreedomNAS signs for its web interface: install FreedomNAS's certificate authority once (System → Certificate) on each computer and phone, then open the vault by the NAS's hostname or address and the Bitwarden apps and browser extensions trust it. For access from outside your network, a certificate of your own domain (reverse proxy) is the lasting way.
